title: Edgecombe Avenue and the Harlem scene
summary: Living at 555 Edgecombe, he tries to recall uptown clubs and the Audubon Ballroom.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: We're still talking about recording, and of course, in New York you did some important recordings. The things for Blue Note, the duets with Fats, which today to me are still some of the best things from that period.

Yeah. I think it's something we should talk about before that time, about the thing with me and Fats. Because that was talked about a long time ago, that we were going to do this date, and we hadn't set it up, we didn't know how we was going to do it or who we was going to do it for. But that was a well-planned date, and it came out good. It was beautiful.
But I was going to talk about when I first came here from California... I was living up on 555 Edgecombe, right over by the Polo Grounds. A lot of the musicians, like Andy
Kirk lived there, and he had his son there, Andy, Junior...
Yeah, who I met briefly, who was a very talented tenor player.
Yeah. Did you meet him?
Yeah.
Yeah, he was a nice kid. But I forgot...
Living up on Edgecombe Avenue.
Oh yeah. Let's see, who played up there? Curly Russell. Sonny Rollins. We played uptown; somebody had a joint up there.
Up on the Hill?
Yeah. John Simmons was...
Bowman's?
No, not Bowman's. Bowman's was afterwards. I was trying to think of the name of this joint. It was up on 147th Street and... What's that street that goes up... Not Edgecombe, but one block over.
Radhurst?
No, no. You're coming down, I'm going up.
You're talking about going East or West of Edgecombe?
West of Edgecombe. I can't think of the name of that street. It wasn't Amsterdam. Another street... Oh, well, I'll get those blocks; I can't think of what street I'm talking about.
But they used to have a club where all the guys used to come up there, especially on Sundays, and we used to play up there all the time.
What about the Audubon Ballroom? They used to have things there, too.
Oh yeah, I played there, too. Yeah, that used to be a hangout. But they don't have nothing happenin' up there now -- that I know of.
But I was trying to think of this club... Now, this was in a club that they had up there on about 147th Street. Now, what's the name of it?
Not Lenox.
No, not Lenox. That's the East side. I'm talking about the West side. What's the name of it...? Near Edgecombe.
Anyway, where were we?
We were just talking about the scene at that time, and your recording with Fats.
